'''Clan Lone''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that followed.

==History==
{{Quote|The man I was with when my people fell... his clan lost all honor after I left. They joined Clan Rook. My old lover dishonors the name Mandalorian. That coward dies with the rest of Rook's filth.|Akaavi Spar|<ref name="TOR:CR" />}}
Around the time the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed,<ref name="TOR:MKJ">{{TORcite|type=codex|Master Kellian Jarro}}''</ref> clan member [[Zadik Lone]] fell in love with fellow Mandalorian [[Akaavi Spar]]. Spar left [[Clan Spar|her own clan]] to be with Lone among his kinsmen, though tragedy would strike when Spar's clan was betrayed and [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. Spar urged Clan Lone to rally to her clan's aid<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> per Mandalorian tradition,<ref name="The Mandalorians: People and Culture">{{InsiderCite|84|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> but the members of Clan Lone refused to go against the Empire. Spar ended her relationship with Zadik, and broke all ties with Clan Lone, leaving to pursue the architects of her family's deaths.<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> Because of their refusal to heed Spar's call for assistance, Clan Lone was dishonored, and many of its members fell in with the [[Clan Rook/Legends|false Mandalorian clan]] of the criminal [[Tayari Rook]], the very man responsible for setting up Clan Spar's downfall. When Akaavi Spar found Rook and his people operating in an encampment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], she attacked and killed anyone who chose to fight instead of flee.<ref name="TOR:CR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Lone was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:CR" />
